title: praxis.requirements-approvals/1
description: Approval records supplied by an approving authority (the operator today; an Ordo decision later) for exclusions, supersessions, not-applicable dispositions and conflict decisions checked by `praxis requirements preservation verify` (REQ-PRES-001). Praxis reads these records and never writes or generates them. See docs/requirements-preservation.md.

covers.description: Requirement, obligation or conflict ids the approval decides.

ordoDecision.description: Reserved: the Ordo decision that backs this approval, once Ordo provides one. Recorded, not verified.
